mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 8.5% signals a deteriorating labor market and impending recession, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 8.5% and decline in industrial production below 90.0 signals a severe economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in deep recession risks.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE>8.5% and INDPRO<90.0, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 24-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-shock recovery regime, a monthly industrial production index exceeding 90.0 signals strengthening manufacturing activity and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO>90 and the regime is post-shock recovery, or the Rank IC for the signal is below 0.03 over any 18-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A retail sales index (RSAFS) exceeding 320,000 (thousands of dollars) signals robust consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate revenue growth expectations rise.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 320,000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production index (INDPRO) below 90.0 signals a contraction in manufacturing output, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 90.0, or the Rank IC is negative over any 24-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a federal funds rate below 0.5% and unemployment rate above 8.5% indicates a severe recession with aggressive monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in deep economic distress.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS<0.5 and UNRATE>8.5, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over any 18-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the housing recovery phase, a rising housing starts index (HOUST) above 500.0 (thousands of units) signals improving housing market conditions and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST>500.0 and the regime is housing recovery phase, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.
